disagreements.reason: PARM values passed to IGYCRCTL resolve to the identical character parameter string 'NODECK,OBJECT,LIST'. NOTE: The simulator hashes PARM text directly into the dataflow version, leading to an oracle disagreement despite documented semantic equivalence.

Step names serve as internal labels for COND checks, backward references, and restart points. Systematically renaming a step along with all internal references preserves exact program invocation, dataset transformations, and execution conditions. NOTE: The oracle keys steps by name and flags step additions/removals as differing execution observables; this case demonstrates documented z/OS semantic equivalence where the oracle's step-identity model disagrees.
